final: WITH ev AS (SELECT b.link_to_event AS le, e.type AS type, AVG(CAST(b.spent AS REAL) / b.amount) AS ev_avg FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY b.link_to_event, e.type), ty AS (SELECT type, AVG(ev_avg) AS type_avg FROM ev GROUP BY type), ov AS (SELECT AVG(type_avg) AS overall FROM ty) SELECT ty.type, ty.type_avg, ty.type_avg / ov.overall AS ratio FROM ty JOIN ov ON ov.overall IS NOT NULL
